report.scene: A hand holds a white ROMOSS power bank with a round digital display showing 31% and a large outlined 20+ graphic on the front.

matching_details: It is a rectangular power bank with rounded corners, the same kind of product as the recall
A large 20 graphic is printed on the lower front, loosely similar to the 20W print on the recalled unit
differing_details: The power bank is white, while the recalled HAIARA W5 PRO is black
The brand ROMOSS is printed on the front center, not HAIARA
A round digital display showing 31% sits at the top front; the official images show no display
The front shows 20 with a plus sign, not 20W
No magnetic ring graphic like the one in official image 2
The shape is longer and narrower than the official images
product.reason_plain: No. This is a white ROMOSS power bank, not the black HAIARA W5 PRO in the recall.
product.reason_technical: Color (white vs black), printed ROMOSS brand, digital percent display, 20+ marking instead of 20W, and different proportions all conflict with the official images; only the product type matches.

actions.evidence: No handwritten or marker writing is visible anywhere on the front of the power bank; only printed ROMOSS, 20+ and the lit 31% display are visible.

photo_source.reason: Handheld shot with a real hand, natural lighting, a lit display and a fabric background, with no screen or print artifacts.

report.retake_tip: This looks like a different power bank, so please photograph the black HAIARA W5 PRO with the word recalled written on it in permanent marker.
